>> James 1:19 My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,
>> James 1:20 for man’s anger does not bring about the righteousness that God desires.
   James 1:21 Therefore, get rid of all moral filth and every expression of evil, and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save your souls.
   James 1:22 Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Otherwise, you are deceiving yourselves.
